title: finding(fields): a lookup value hydrated from a bare id on mount is labelled before the referenced object's schema loads and is never relabelled, so its chip ignores `nameField`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`: the mount-time hydration effect and `findOption`.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) at the ACCEPT of objectui#10343 (PR objectui#10479). Source: the dev's `out_of_scope_findings` (class a) and the at-tier contract review of that PR, which read it at source. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

When a lookup mounts with a stored value (a bare record id), its hydration effect fetches the record and builds the chip's option before `getObjectSchema` has resolved the referenced object's schema:

- the effect captures `refObjectSchema` while it is still `null`;
- its dependency list is eslint-disabled and does not include `refObjectSchema`;
- `findOption` then resolves the already-hydrated id from `pickerResolvedRecords`, so the schema's arrival never relabels it.

⇒ The chip is labelled on the no-schema path (the `name` guess), while the dropdown, the read cell and the record page read the object's declared `nameField`. This is the common edit-form state: open an existing record whose lookup is filled.

## Reproduction

A throwaway probe was run at PR head `600c330` and not committed. Value `'c1'`; the object's `nameField` is `contract_no`; the row has `name: 'Acme'` and `contract_no: 'HT-001'`.

| moment | chip label |
|:--|:--|
| after mount (hydrated) | `Acme` (probe read `Remove Acme`) |
| right after picking the same record | `HT-001` (`handleSelect` caches the built option) |
| after a reload | `Acme` again |

The dropdown option for the same record reads `HT-001`. ⚠️ These readings are the dev's; the reviewer confirmed the mechanism at source (`LookupField.tsx:748-855` at head). The seat did not re-run them. The base behaviour is a code reading only. On the base, the dropdown and the chip both showed `name`, so this is pre-existing, not a regression of objectui#10479. After that PR, fewer surfaces disagree than on the base.

## Fix direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The label is derived data, so it should follow the schema when the schema arrives. Two ways, and choosing between them is a design step:
- relabel hydrated options when `refObjectSchema` resolves;
- defer hydration labelling until the schema is known.

⛔ Not a React `key=` remount (AGENTS.md §5 #8).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (the search API answers 403 here), oldest updated 2026-09-18T06:33Z. Pattern `hydrat… (refObjectSchema|lookup) … (label|schema)` or `refObjectSchema … stale` ⇒ 1 hit, PR objectui#10479 (the origin). Lit control `recordToOption` ⇒ 4 hits. ⇒ No duplicate.

Dedupe words: `LookupField hydration refObjectSchema stale` · `lookup chip label before schema loads` · `hydrated lookup label ignores nameField`
